summary: P1 Features Testing - Count Escape Squares, Win Streak Mood Override, and related APIs. All 16 backend tests pass. Fixed a critical bug in CoachGameSession.from_dict() that was causing 500 errors when loading sessions with escape_square_quizzes field.

integration_issues.issue: CoachHome.jsx is imported in App.js but not used in any route. The /home route uses HomePage instead. The win_streak_banner and coach-home data-testids exist in CoachHome but won't be visible since the component isn't rendered.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Wire CoachHome component to a route if the win-streak-banner UI is needed (currently HomePage is used for /home)
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed: CoachGameSession.from_dict() now filters unknown fields to prevent TypeError when new fields are added to DB documents

success_rate.frontend: 90% (Play with Coach and Home pages load correctly, coaching sidebar works)

test_credentials: Dev mode: DEV_MODE=true, dev_user_local via Dev Login button

bug_fixed.description: CoachGameSession.from_dict() was failing with TypeError when loading sessions containing escape_square_quizzes field
bug_fixed.root_cause: The dataclass didn't have escape_square_quizzes field but the DB documents did. from_dict() passed all fields to constructor causing TypeError.
bug_fixed.fix: Added field filtering in from_dict() to only pass known dataclass fields to constructor
